_comment: Deployment settings. Training reads these and never overwrites them, so a retrain cannot reset how much the EA stakes. Any explicit command-line flag still wins.
_risk_from_kelly: derive the three caps from the measured growth-optimal stake f* = E[R]/E[R^2], per symbol, instead of using fixed percentages. Past 2 x f* compounding turns negative even on a positive edge, so the High preset is deliberately pinned to that ceiling.
_risk_pcts: fallback only, used when a symbol shows no positive edge and f* cannot be computed
